body_lead: Karnataka is likely to soon have a state-of-the-art Integrated Command Centre exclusively dedicated to powering the Cyber Command Unit (CCU), which houses multiple wings, including cybercrime and cyber security. According to a Home Department source, the CCU has proposed setting up the Karnataka Cyber Command Centre (K4C), with its headquarters in Bengaluru and mini hubs in all districts. The CCU, which was set up mid-last year, currently houses cybercrime, cyber security, and the Information Disorder Tackling Unit (IDTU).
